claim_gate.reason: Unequal-pair sectors have zero one-copy signal but explicit nontrivial collective spectra. The audit is finite and omits mixed irrep tuples, growing recurrences, and frame inversion.

falsifiers_triggered: Zero one-copy bridge character does not imply a scalar correlated multi-copy frame block.
Every unequal-pair W_3 irrep has an explicit information-threshold block.
Finite unequal-pair spectra can have kernels and multiple eigenvalues.
Repeated copies of one physical irrep do not cover mixed physical-irrep tuples.
Finite dense diagonalization does not provide an all-n recurrence or coherent inverse.

induced_representation_contract.base_action: (a,b;0) acts by rho_lambda(a) tensor rho_mu(b) and rho_mu(a) tensor rho_lambda(b) on the two summands
induced_representation_contract.space: (V_lambda tensor V_mu) direct_sum (V_mu tensor V_lambda), lambda != mu
induced_representation_contract.swap_action: The nontrivial wreath swap exchanges the summands.

summary: Diagonalized 35 unequal-pair physical frame blocks; 19 have nontrivial collective spectra and 3 reach the S_3 information threshold, while mixed tuples and all-n recurrences remain zero.
